verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents central configuration: one dedicated `coderabbit` repository holding a `.coderabbit.yaml` that applies to the entire organization (coderabbit-docs-14). The `@coderabbitai configuration` command returns the resolved YAML for any PR (coderabbit-docs-20), and auto-review settings, path instructions and path filters can be defined in that config (coderabbit-docs-21, coderabbit-docs-70, coderabbit-docs-8, coderabbit-docs-69). How exceptions are managed centrally is only implied by the resolved-config concept, not documented. Missing for 10: documented central exception/override management (inheritance and precedence rules for per-repo overrides), evidence of rollout at hundreds-of-repos scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
